# .github / ISSUE_TEMPLATE

Issue templates for requesting **Foundation Layer** changes. Each one asks for what that kind of change needs (owner, env, naming, approvals).

| Template | Request |
| --- | --- |
| `foundation-layer-todo-gcp-folder.md` | a new GCP folder |
| `foundation-layer-todo-gcp-project.md` | a new GCP project |
| `foundation-layer-todo-gcp-networking.md` | VPC / subnet / firewall work |
| `foundation-layer-todo-gcs-bucket.md` | a new GCS bucket |
| `foundation-layer-todo-gce-vm.md` | a new (baked) GCE VM |
